name: Mike Johnson

lean.basis: Republican congressman since 2017 and Speaker since 2023.

current_role: Speaker of the House (since October 2023; until January 2027)
summary: Mike Johnson, a Louisiana Republican, has been Speaker since October 2023 and steered Trump’s agenda through a razor-thin House majority, relying on Trump to settle revolts in his conference. He won a sixth term in November 2026, but Republicans lost the House, and he told staff he would not run for minority leader.
